company.name: WorkOS
company.description: WorkOS provides the APIs and tools you need to make your app enterprise ready — Single Sign-On, Directory Sync, Audit Logs, and more.

hero.heading: Enterprise-ready authentication, in minutes
hero.subheading: AuthKit gives you a complete authentication stack — Single Sign-On, Directory Sync, MFA, and more — without the enterprise complexity.

features.title: Single Sign-On
features.description: Integrate with every major identity provider through a single OIDC or SAML flow.

features.title: Directory Sync
features.description: Automatically provision and deprovision users from any HR or identity system via SCIM.

features.title: Multi-Factor Auth
features.description: Add TOTP, WebAuthn, and passkeys with a flip of a switch — no extra code required.

features.title: Audit Logs
features.description: Stream every authentication event to a searchable, compliance-ready audit log.
